html:
Here is the first image since acquiring a QSI583wsg CCD camera. It is the nebula NGC896 located in the constellation Cassiopeia. NGC896 is an emission nebula made of hydrogen atoms.



The technical details
Date:  2011/10/25
Optical train = AT8RC @ F8 - astrodon Ha 5nm filter - QSI583wsg @ -15c
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the TheSky6 software and guided with phd, QHY5 on the QSI
Acquisition with Nebulosity
Site: At home
5 frames of 1200 seconds
Bias and dark applied
Pre-processing and processing in PixInsight
